subject: general
question: The Deomali is the highest mountain peak of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Odisha.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Deomali (1672m) mountain peak is situated on the Eastern Ghat in Odisha.
 
• It is the highest peak of Odisha.
 
• Deomali is a mountain peak in the Chandragiri-Pottangi subrange of the Eastern Ghats.
 
• It is located near Koraput town in the Koraput district of southern Odisha, India.
